label: Ridgeline Native Full Audit
changes: Track summary: a hut opened from a track or walk returns to it when its X (or back) is pressed; the summary no longer closes on a drag down or a tap on the map, only with its X.

Route and track stats size to their text and line up by their tops; the route tools (Edit, Undo, Export GPX, Delete point) take the height of the tallest, so two-line labels are never cut off or out of line; the route sheet's compact stop fits them.
DOC's walks drawn as track lines from zoom 9 until the map's own tracks start at zoom 12 (LINZ's vector tiles carry tracks from zoom 12 only); no names until then.

NZ Topo chosen at the phone's pixel density (a 256 px tile over 256 screen pixels, not 256 points): about twice as sharp on a 2x screen; LINZ letters each zoom at the same pixel size, so labels stay as large.
Dark mode following the phone (also when it changes while open); status and navigation bars take the app's background with icons readable on it (they were white on white).
Hunting permit areas shaded with translucent blaze-orange hatching under a bolder outline; data tiles now cover a tilted view's distant tiles (they were cut at 32, so distant areas never loaded).
